newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank says sets up Internet web site.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank says sets up Internet web site.

text.p: The Bundesbank has caught up with the future, announcing on Tuesday that it has set up a site on the Internet.
The German central bank said it was taking advantage of the "fast-growing information medium" by setting up a site on the World Wide Web at the address http://www.bundesbank.de.

Information initially available on the Bundesbank web site will include general information and news releases about the central bank, the German currency and also plans for the planned single European currency.
The Bundesbank said the web site will be expanded in the coming months.
A spokesman for the Bundesbank said market-moving announcements would not be released on a real-time basis for now, although this could be a possibility later.
